Please be assured that we are fully aware of long waiting times and are actively working to increase appointment availability as much as possible within NHS resources, which are unfortunately limited.

The steps we are taking include:

Recruiting additional GPs, which is not always straightforward given the national shortage of doctors.

Reducing duplicate bookings, ensuring patients are only booked once for the same clinical issue.

Limiting double appointments unless clinically necessary (for example, when an interpreter is required), to allow more patients to be seen in each clinic.

Addressing repeated non-attendance, as a significant number of appointments are lost each month when patients do not attend or cancel in advance. When this happens repeatedly, it prevents other patients from accessing care. For this reason, patients who miss three appointments without notice may be reviewed for removal from the practice list, in line with NHS guidance.

These measures are intended to use our appointment capacity as fairly and safely as possible, so we can support the greatest number of patients.

Thank you again for taking the time to leave this review, we truly appreciate it.

Julie
